test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Water __is using in every.__ cell of your body.
solution:
The correct answer is** Is used in every. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence** is used in every. **
 
• The given sentence is a passive of Present Indefinite tense. In the passive form, we always use the third form of a verb.
 
• Thus the correct answer is used in every.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are three types of tenses- **Present, Past and Future**.
 
• Every type of tense has 4 subtypes of tenses- **Indefinite, continuous, perfect and perfect continuous.**
 
• We usually make **passive sentences** only for **Indefinite, continuous and perfect in the present, past tenses and future indefinite.**
